evidence.title: GitHub - peetzweg/opendisplay: Use an iPhone, iPad, or spare Mac as a true second display for your Mac without restrictions.

name: OpenDisplay
summary: Free open-source app that turns an iPhone, iPad or spare Mac into a true extended display for a Mac.
description: Self-hosted alternative to Apple Sidecar, Duet Display and Luna Display: extends a Mac's desktop onto an iPhone, iPad or another Mac over USB or WiFi, with H.264/HEVC hardware encoding, Retina/HiDPI output up to 5120×2880 and touch and two-finger-scroll input. Two small apps — a sender for the main Mac and a receiver — with no account and no dongle.
contains: true display extension, not just mirroring
H.264/HEVC via VideoToolbox; ~12–30 ms measured latency
Retina/HiDPI up to 5120×2880 at up to 60 fps
iPhone/iPad receiver app and a separate Mac receiver (macOS 12+)
